Overall, I highly recommend this product to anyone looking for an affordable yet effective way to prepare their morning coffee.

A few weeks ago I received an email from a friend asking me what I would recommend for a home office setup. Since then I have been working on a system using a standing desk and a computer stand. I am currently running a laptop on a small table atop a tall standing desk, which works well but does require constant adjustment as one can see in the picture below. However, after seeing this standing desk I decided to upgrade!
The build quality looks great, but it has several issues that will prevent me from recommending it:
1) The legs do not extend out fully - they sit too close together and make it difficult to get comfortable.
2) There is no way to adjust the height without having to remove both the keyboard tray and mouse pad from the desk.
3) While the desktop itself seems sturdy, there is still plenty of space between the edge of the monitor and the underside of the desk. This means that when I want to use my printer/scanner, it often falls down onto the desk.
4) The desk doesn’t come with any side shelves.
5) Even though the top of the desk is level, the edges don’t meet properly, causing a slight wobble.
6) To adjust the angle of the screen, you must first take apart the entire desk, remove the monitor bracket, unscrew the legs, and rotate the base until the monitor is at the desired angle. Then put everything back together. This takes a lot longer than simply turning the monitor around to align it correctly.
Overall, while the design may appeal to those who value simplicity and minimalism, I think this desk needs more work before it becomes a viable option for someone looking for a productivity solution.
Output: Negative

Answer according to: 3/4 of the way through my first week back from leave, I thought I’d check out some new sites. As a member of this site, I am entitled to get 50p off any order over £25, so I headed straight there. I had a look around, and decided to go for a few bits and pieces – not quite enough to warrant getting home delivery (£6.99), but just about enough to justify a visit to the local shop anyway! The items were all relatively small (<£5) which made the total cost almost exactly £18, which seemed like value for money. The website itself looked clean and easy to navigate, although I did find myself struggling a bit trying to figure out what each item entailed – no instructions, no diagrams etc. It took me a while to get going! When placing my order, I selected the option to pay via PayPal – this wasn’t something I was expecting to have to do, and initially I was a little concerned. However, I managed to complete payment without any problems and received confirmation shortly afterwards. Unfortunately, my parcel didn’t arrive until after the cutoff time (I ordered on Wednesday evening). I emailed the seller and they kindly replied within minutes to say that they would try their best to sort things out. They also mentioned that they could ship it out early next day, but unfortunately I couldn’t guarantee when I would receive it – they said they wouldn’t know till Friday morning. Fortunately, I was able to contact the seller again later in the day, and they agreed to send the parcel out immediately. So far, so good – I’ve been waiting patiently for the parcel to come through, but now I’m starting to worry slightly about whether I’ll ever hear anything more about it. On Saturday afternoon, however, I got a call from the seller telling me that my parcel had arrived and asking if everything was OK. I told him I hadn’t heard anything since Thursday, but he assured me that it should be arriving today. At least we’re safe for the moment! Overall, I’m very happy with my order and the quality of the goods themselves. However, I feel a little let down that I haven’t yet heard anything further regarding my parcel. There seems to be nothing wrong with the transaction, but it does seem strange that the parcel hasn’t shown up yet… Perhaps I need to speak to someone higher up than myself?
